name: @zhushanwen/pi-wool-shared
description: Shared protocol-agnostic foundation for wool provider extensions (@zhushanwen/pi-wool-*) — provider scaffolding (registerProvider/streamSimple/oauth wiring), manage-command protocol (taiji->extension), account status schema, model catalog store (event-boundary replace, no TTL, in-package snapshot fallback), SSE parsing, and a fixture-driven streamSimple conformance test harness. Shared library, not a Pi extension.
